statement: One authored Norway spruce calibration hypothesis for the 350 stems per hectare open grown treatment of src.makinen2006. It composes ledger rows into a renderable structure. It is not a species model, not a world plant, not a production generator, and it cannot become any of those by changing a label: the graph validator refuses any artifact_class but visual-calibration-fixture. Structure that is measured comes from the ledger; everything else is a named choice in the same ledger.

frame.note: The browser viewer is Y up and converts (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y) at load. The conversion lives only in the viewer; every number in the graph and geometry files is in this frame.

crown_diameter.role: fixture envelope target, solved for by fx.envelope_fit_scalar
crown_diameter.note: The solver targets the treatment MEAN so the acceptance test is exact. One tree need not equal a population mean, and the reported range travels with the target in the ledger, the build manifest and the viewer readout. Retargeting to a point inside the range is a one line change here.

crown_ratio_pct.handling: reported next to the fixture's own value, never reconciled and never used as an input

lowest_living_whorl_m.handling: adopted through fx.first_live_whorl_m as a choice, not as a derivation

deliberately_not_consumed.why: reported proportions and a Fisher p do not supply transition coefficients; the marginals are consumed separately and the conditional structure is not modelled
direction of effect only, no functional form; an invented positional angle law would read as a finding
this fixture has no light state, and coefficients cannot be synthesized from an abstract
wrong population and an unestablished order convention; emitted as a diagnostic under both alignments instead
context for which column is rendered; choosing or interpolating a density is a world decision, not an art one
unavailable for this population; the other study's 10 year stand age is not transferable

branch.note: The inspected branch is EXTRACTED from the whole tree graph below, not generated separately. Node ids are preserved and the branch local frame carries a 4x4 local_to_tree transform back to tree coordinates.

budgets.note: Explicit test settings that bound what this prototype will emit. They are rendering constraints, not botanical parameters, and a tier that exceeds one is reported as unavailable with its measured projection rather than quietly reduced.

wood_radial_segments.note: Rendering budget settings per detail tier and branch order. Order 3 wood is dropped at mid, and all orders above 1 at far; their foliage is still represented by that tier's proxies.

cameras.note: Fixed comparison poses in fixture frame metres, fitted to the MEASURED bounds of the compiled geometry (branch x 0 to 3.17, z 0 to -1.80; tree crown 6.2 m across, 15.7 m tall). The same pose is used for every available tier of its subject, so a near, mid and far capture differ only in geometry. Orbit poses are generated by the viewer around the named target at the named height.

display_fixtures.note: Neutral display aids, not world geography. Off in beauty captures.

revision: v0.2, after the peer evidence patch

whorl_strata.note: Whorl groups counted FROM THE APEX, matching the source's branch strata table. Whorl index 0 is the lowest live whorl, so its distance from the apex is fx.whorl_count minus its index.

reports.note: Read by the build for side by side reporting only. A row here never changes a vertex.

superseded_choices.note: Choices the peer evidence patch replaced with measurements. Kept in the ledger with their rationale so the record shows what was assumed before the evidence arrived.
